description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides an API client for the Memory Flip Card game frontend. It includes functions for building API URLs, handling errors, making fetch requests, and specific API calls such as health check, create game, get game state, flip card, and reset game.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL with the /api prefix based on the base URL and provided path.

methods.name: toApiError
methods.description: Normalizes an error payload into a standard Error object with additional info such as status, url, code, and details.

methods.name: request
methods.description: A fetch wrapper that handles JSON request/response, error normalization, and response parsing.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: healthCheck
methods.description: Performs a quick API health check to verify backend availability.

methods.name: createGame
methods.description: Creates a new game session with specified board size, returning the session info.

methods.name: getGame
methods.description: Fetches the current state of a specific game session by game ID.

methods.name: flipCard
methods.description: Performs a flip action on a specified card index within a game session.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets an existing game session to a new game with the same configuration.
